method_descriptions.BiLo-NSGA: NSGA-II core + forward insertion + atomic backward-forward substitution + dependency moves + feasibility recovery.
method_descriptions.NSGA-III: pymoo NSGA-III with Das-Dennis reference directions.
method_descriptions.AHP-TOPSIS: AHP-derived weights + TOPSIS ranking + greedy fill.
method_descriptions.Pareto Local Search: Multi-start Pareto local search with add, delete, and swap moves under a fixed 1600-neighbour budget.
method_descriptions.Ablation-LegacyDeletion: Atomic substitution replaced by the legacy standalone greedy deletion.
method_descriptions.Ablation-RandomMutationOnly: Local search replaced by high-rate random mutation.
method_descriptions.Ablation-LooseBudget: Search at 1.2x budget, evaluated at the true budget.

evaluation: standard hypervolume, fixed seeded normalization bounds, ref point 1.1^d; feasible non-dominated front only
statistics: Mann-Whitney U two-sided, Holm correction per experiment
